The integration of these interactions implies that 2-Hydroxyquinoline may act as a modulator of the carbonic anhydrase pathway, possibly by targeting the mitochondrial isoform, which is then inhibited by Garcimangosone D, ultimately leading to the inhibition of Carbonic anhydrase 4. The evidence suggests a possible dependency on the carbonic anhydrase pathway, with 2-Hydroxyquinoline serving as a potential modulator in this cascade.
